correctness.rationale: Chang 2026 Corollary 4.9, Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 5.5 give the exactly stated global premises. For any nonunit minimum pi epsilon, five unit minima give M b = (sum b)1. Each entry of MM^T is the rational real trace of two explicitly inverted cyclotomic elements; the packaged exact Python rational checker establishes G with determinant 75625, so b is constant. Embedding compatibility forces the constant rational. Conversely, scaling a0 by rational and unit norms transports the minimum 10 and its unit and nonunit minimizers to every listed weight. Tests are exact finite checks of the new determinant, not a substitute for the cited infinite lemma.
